items.mainDefect: Supplying a non-empty totpCode bypasses password verification when authenticating with a valid backup code.

secondary.defect: The backup code is consumed before authorization finishes, so a later failure can burn it without granting a session.

items.mainDefect: The disable-2FA endpoint compares secret backup codes using a non-constant-time comparison.

secondary.defect: A non-string backupCode causes replaceAll to throw a TypeError, turning invalid input into a server error.

items.mainDefect: The checked-state assertion tests the truthiness of a Promise and therefore always passes.

secondary.defect: The first test fails to close the new backup-code dialog before expecting the 2FA switch to be checked.

items.mainDefect: The copy-button test asserts only a toast and cannot detect missing or incorrect clipboard contents.

secondary.defect: The copy handler displays success without awaiting clipboard.writeText, so it reports success even when copying fails.

items.mainDefect: The login form schema omits backupCode, causing validation to strip the submitted value.

secondary.defect: The login submit handler does not forward backupCode in the nextAuth.signIn credentials payload.
